question: How many orders were placed in 1995?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1995

question: How many distinct customers placed an order in 1994?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o_custkey) AS n FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1994

question: What is the total revenue across all line items?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem

question: Total revenue per region in 1995
gold_sql: SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1995 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Top 5 suppliers by revenue in 1996
gold_sql: SELECT s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1996 GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Average order total price by market segment
gold_sql: SELECT c.c_mktsegment, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_total FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY avg_total DESC

question: How many parts in the brand 'Brand#11'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM part WHERE p_brand = 'Brand#11'

question: Top 10 customers by total order value
gold_sql: SELECT c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS spend FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: Number of orders by order status
gold_sql: SELECT o_orderstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY o_orderstatus ORDER BY n DESC

question: Revenue per ship mode in 1994
gold_sql: SELECT l.l_shipmode, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1994 GROUP BY l.l_shipmode ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Monthly order count in 1995
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o_orderdate)::INTEGER AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1995 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: How many suppliers are in Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY'

question: Top 5 nations by customer count
gold_sql: SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Average discount per ship mode
gold_sql: SELECT l_shipmode, AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY avg_discount DESC

question: Number of orders where order priority is '1-URGENT'
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'

question: Revenue per market segment in 1995
gold_sql: SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1995 GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Total quantity shipped per region
gold_sql: SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem l JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY qty DESC

question: Top 5 parts by total revenue
gold_sql: SELECT p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many distinct ship modes exist?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l_shipmode) AS n FROM lineitem

question: Total revenue in Q1 1995
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-03-31'

question: Average part retail price by manufacturer
gold_sql: SELECT p_mfgr, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_mfgr ORDER BY avg_price DESC

question: How many returned line items in 1995?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'R' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1995

question: Yearly revenue from 1993 to 1996
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)::INTEGER AS year, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) BETWEEN 1993 AND 1996 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Top 5 customers by number of orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name ORDER BY n_orders DESC LIMIT 5

question: Revenue per region in Asia in 1995
gold_sql: SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1995 GROUP BY r.r_name
